overall_summary: Initial romantic/self-respect content built low-to-moderate sample views (4 to 41 views), but recent family and relationship emotional shorts (specifically about mothers, fathers, and husbands/wives) drastically outperformed them, peaking with over 1,400 views on a marital relationship topic. This indicates the audience heavily favors grounded, universal relationship and family emotional dynamics over niche phone-deletion self-respect tropes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on family members and partners (e.g., Mother, Father, Wife) generated hundreds to over 1,400 views (e.g., 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' got 1466 views), completely eclipsing text-deletion niches.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core focus toward broader domestic, relationship, and family emotional bonds while keeping the 'Dil Ki Diary' touch.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles addressing common domestic or interpersonal friction ('आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना' - 288 views) outperformed abstract poetry or phone-cleaning metaphors.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational hooks that call out everyday relationship oversights.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeatedly making shorts about clearing phone storage, unpinning chats, and deleting keyboard names yielded low single-digit to low double-digit views (4 to 41 views).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize repetitive tech-based heartbreak metaphors and explore broader real-life emotional friction points.
